method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, mannequin template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 7) then animate_character v3 per direction (keep_first_frame=false, palette passed; canvases come back 36-44 px and are centred on 32 by the build script). All four facings are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored. Diagonal direction_prompts keys are required by the tool and were filled with 'unused diagonal: ...' placeholders; no diagonal was generated.
prompt: Small wax sentinel, a stout chibi guardian figure made of pale cream candle wax, a melted drooping wax dome helmet with one glowing amber ember slit for eyes, thick rounded wax limbs with drip lines, holding a short stubby bronze candlestick shield-and-spike in its RIGHT hand, a vermilion wax seal stamped on its chest, wax puddle at the feet. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: stands guard and breathes slowly, the wax body sways very slightly, the candlestick stays held in the right hand, the red seal stays on the chest, no effects

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, stands guard, breathes slowly, the candlestick stays in his right hand on the viewer's left
direction_prompts.west: facing left, stands guard, breathes slowly, the candlestick stays in front of him
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, stands guard, breathes slowly, the candlestick stays visible on the viewer's right
direction_prompts.east: facing right, stands guard, breathes slowly, the candlestick stays in front of him

walk.action_description: marches forward with short stiff heavy steps, the candlestick stays held in the right hand, the red seal stays on the chest, no effects

direction_prompts.south: walks toward the viewer with short stiff steps, candlestick stays in his right hand on the viewer's left
direction_prompts.west: walks to the left with short stiff steps, candlestick stays in front of him
direction_prompts.north: walks away from the viewer, seen from behind, short stiff steps, candlestick stays visible on the viewer's right
direction_prompts.east: walks to the right with short stiff steps, candlestick stays in front of him

telegraph.action_description: raises the candlestick high in the right hand and leans back, the wax body swells and the ember slit eyes glow brighter, preparing a downward strike, no effects

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, raises the candlestick high with his right hand (viewer's left) and leans back
direction_prompts.west: facing left, raises the candlestick high in front of him and leans back
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, raises the candlestick high on the viewer's right and leans back
direction_prompts.east: facing right, raises the candlestick high in front of him and leans back

strike.action_description: slams the candlestick down hard in front of it with the right hand, the wax body lurches forward, then recovers upright, no effects

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, slams the candlestick down toward the viewer with his right hand (viewer's left), lurches forward, then stands up
direction_prompts.west: facing left, slams the candlestick down in front of him toward the left, lurches forward, then stands up
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, slams the candlestick down away from the viewer, lurches forward, then stands up
direction_prompts.east: facing right, slams the candlestick down in front of him toward the right, lurches forward, then stands up

strike.regeneration_action_description: slams the short bronze candlestick down in front of it with the right hand, the wax body lurches forward, then recovers upright, the candlestick stays gripped in the hand in every frame, no slash, no sparks, no effects

regeneration_direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, his right arm is on the viewer's RIGHT and holds the bronze candlestick; he swings it down and forward past his right side, lurches forward, then stands up; the candlestick stays visible and gripped in every frame; no sparks
regeneration_direction_prompts.east: facing right, slams the bronze candlestick down in front of him toward the right with the arm nearest the viewer, lurches forward, then stands up; the candlestick stays gripped in his hand in every frame, never detached; no slash, no sparks
